title: Allow disabling 'wrapping around' for feature to switch tasks on scroll
line: The Task Manager has a new "Wrap around" option, so scrolling over it can stop at the first or last task instead of jumping to the other end.
explanation: When scrolling over the Task Manager is set to cycle through tasks, activateNextPrevTask() in TaskTools.js always jumped from the last task to the first one and from the first to the last, so with touchpads and smooth wheels it was easy to overshoot the wanted window. The change adds a wheelWrapAround setting (default on, so nothing changes for existing users) with a "Wrap around" checkbox under "Scrolling behavior", enabled only for the two cycling modes; with it off, scrolling past either end keeps the first or last task active.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: make wrapping around when scrolling optional

Scrolling over the task manager always jumped from the last task back to
the first one and vice versa, so it was easy to overshoot the wanted one.
Add a "Wrap around" option, enabled by default, to stop at either end.

BUG: 404781

media.caption: Master: Info Center is the last task; scrolling down over the Task Manager wraps to Dolphin, the first task, and later again
Wrap around off: scrolling down on the last task (Konsole) stays there, scrolling up walks to Dolphin and stays on it
Master: the Behavior page has no way to turn wrapping off
New "Wrap around" checkbox under Scrolling behavior
